feedback.text: I saw the shoes in an ad, but the product page did not tell me if my size was available.
The checkout showed a payment error, so I tried again and worried I had been charged twice.
After placing my order I could not find clear tracking or delivery status.
The item looked available, but it was out of stock when I reached checkout.
My order page still says processing even though the parcel was shipped yesterday.
I wanted to know whether the jacket was in stock before I travelled to the store.
